captions: Open a Governance briefing and choose Generate PDF.
The briefing uses the applied header scope and snapshot.
scenes.title: Create a briefing PDF

captions: Open an explorer and filter the inventory you want to share.
Export Excel includes all matching rows, with an export timestamp in UTC.
scenes.title: Download the filtered rows

captions: Open Topology Explorer and choose a starting CI.
Choose the analysis mode and review the graph before generating an Impact Report.
scenes.title: Show how items are connected

captions: Generate the report and wait for the progress dialog to finish.
Before sharing, check the downloaded file against the scope, snapshot and records.
scenes.title: Check the downloaded file
